author: Komorebi P.
main_claim: For integer polynomial systems at a lower root modulo p^L, L>=1, a surjective full actual Jacobian modulo prime p supplies a coordinate permutation and a continuous chart homeomorphism of the entire original p-adic root locus, with actual selected-coordinate projection as inverse and congruence equivalence at every depth.
additional_claims: Local surjectivity onto arbitrary p-adic targets for rectangular polynomial maps
Square local inverse homeomorphisms with preservation and reflection of every congruence depth
Fixed-coordinate continuous root graphs when the solved block is surjective

computation_manifest.validation: PASS with output hashes; legacy v1 provenance limits retained

preserved_archive.coverage: Every uncompressed prior file must be represented by an identical content hash in this release. Older prior-archive coverage records are inherited, not independently rerun during recovery.

environmental_failures: Workspace maintenance removed unpublished chart sources and unfinished pre-recovery verification logs; reconstructed sources freshly verified.
Post-recovery attempts 01 and 02 stopped with disk exhaustion; available logs and failure records retained.
Attempt 03 failed at compiler startup because the path adapter copy used full /tmp; attempt 04 used the unchanged shipped adapter directly and tmpfs output.
remaining: Weighted nonlinear lifting for rationally invertible nonunit Jacobians
Prescribed-parameter cokernel interface and singular compatible towers
Native13.2 presentation invariance and native13.3 global/completed descent
Remaining historical edge identities, exact higher differences, further least periods, general Mahler valuations, arbitrary-row exact tails
not_claimed: Analyticity or differentiability of the chart
A lifting interface for arbitrary p-adic polynomial coefficients
Arbitrary prescribed coordinates from full Jacobian surjectivity
Global uniqueness across residue balls or rectangular uniqueness without fixed parameters
New mathematical novelty or a second independent Lean kernel
